_comment: TEMPLATE. Alternate series names -> the canonical name, so one series known
by several titles (English / Japanese / romaji / abbreviation) resolves to
one place. Every name below is INVENTED and matches the other example
Consulted by archive.py's franchise resolution AND by shortname matching, so
the canonical value is a plain SERIES NAME, never a shortname code -- it then
follows whatever filing that canonical already has (a layout.json franchise
folder if one exists, otherwise the shortname file).
Matching is case-insensitive and ignores trailing punctuation, so you only
need an entry for genuinely different names, not for casing variants.
Aliases are single-hop: resolve.py resolves the target before storing, so an
alias never points at another alias.
Normally written for you by resolve.py's 'Use existing shortname' confirm
panel -- hand-editing is fine too. Copy this file to series_aliases.json
(same folder) to start your own; the real one stays out of git.
